details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a widespread downturn on October 15, with Bitcoin falling and altcoins seeing sharper declines. Higher-than-expected US September CPI data (3.7% YoY) triggered concerns about potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. This macroeconomic pressure led to significant liquidations, with over $970 million in leveraged positions closed, pushing Bitcoin to retest critical support around $80,000-$81,000 and causing many altcoins to drop over 12%.
title: US Inflation & Fed Hike Fears Drive Crypto Market Down

details: After a brief positive inflow, US-listed Ethereum spot ETFs experienced significant outflows on October 14-15, 2026. On October 14, these ETFs saw approximately $129.5 million in outflows, following a $24.8 million inflow on October 13. An additional $60.3 million was withdrawn on October 15, with BlackRock's iShares Ethereum Trust (ETHA) and Grayscale's Ethereum Trust (ETHE) recording the largest redemptions. This selling pressure contributed to Ethereum's price falling around 5-6% to approximately $2,365.
title: Ethereum ETFs See Major Outflows, ETH Price Declines

details: The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has proposed new rules and amendments to its custody framework. The proposal would allow registered investment advisers and regulated funds to self-custody certain crypto assets under specific conditions and would recognize state trust companies as qualified crypto custodians. This initiative aims to provide clearer guidelines and close regulatory gaps for digital asset custody.
title: SEC Proposes New Crypto Custody Rules for Funds & Advisers

details: Despite macroeconomic headwinds like inflation fears, potential Fed rate hikes, and ETF outflows, Bitcoin demonstrated resilience on October 15, bouncing off the crucial $80,000 support level. Analysts note that Bitcoin's correlation with gold has reached its highest point since November 2020, suggesting investors are increasingly viewing it as a supplementary safe-haven asset amidst global economic uncertainties and rising sovereign debt.
title: Bitcoin Shows Resilience, Growing Gold-Like Safe-Haven Appeal

details: On October 15, XRP and Dogecoin perpetual futures recorded the highest funding rates among five major cryptocurrencies, reaching an annualized 10.9%. Dogecoin also led in open-interest growth with a 4.94% increase to $219.1 million. The consistently positive funding rates indicate that long positions outnumbered short positions, with traders holding bullish views paying those with short positions, signaling active trader interest.
title: XRP & Dogecoin Futures Show Strong Bullish Positioning
